description:
## Finding

`pkix-lint/Cargo.toml` is missing **three** pieces of metadata that every other workspace crate has:

1. `keywords`
2. `categories`
3. `[package.metadata.docs.rs]` block

Every other workspace crate sets all three.

```
$ for f in pkix-*/Cargo.toml; do echo "==$f=="; grep -E "keywords|categories" "$f"; done
==pkix-ac/Cargo.toml==
keywords    = ["x509", "certificate", "attr-cert", "pki", "authorization"]
categories  = ["cryptography", "no-std"]
==pkix-chain/Cargo.toml==
keywords    = ["x509", "certificate", "pki", "pkix", "chain"]
categories  = ["cryptography"]
... (every crate has both)
==pkix-lint/Cargo.toml==
(no keywords)
(no categories)
```

## Impact

- **Crates.io discoverability**: `pkix-lint` won't appear in the `cryptography` category browse, won't surface for keyword searches like `lint`, `x509`, `cabforum`.
- **docs.rs**: without `[package.metadata.docs.rs]`, docs.rs builds pkix-lint with default features only. The `serde` feature's items (Serialize/Deserialize impls on Finding, DeviatedFinding, EvaluationReport) won't appear in rendered docs.

## Fix

Add to `pkix-lint/Cargo.toml`:

```toml
keywords    = ["x509", "certificate", "lint", "cabforum", "pki"]
categories  = ["cryptography"]

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
all-features = true
rustdoc-args = ["--cfg", "docsrs"]
```

(Crates.io enforces `keywords ≤ 5` and only allows category names from a fixed list.)

## Priority

P3 — small but consistent metadata gap; affects publish hygiene.
title: P3: pkix-lint Cargo.toml missing keywords, categories, and [package.metadata.docs.rs]
